annotations.title: Create a Google Ads client account under a manager

description: Create a new Google Ads client account under a manager (MCC) account shared with this brand: name, currency (ISO, permanent) and timeZone (IANA, permanent); optionally emailAddress + accessRole to invite its owner. Google accounts cannot be deleted, only cancelled, and Google decides which managers may create accounts. Needs confirm:true after the user agrees; dryRun:true has Google validate it. The new account has no billing (google_ads_billing). To build on it here, add it with set_connector_accounts. Free.

dryRun.description: true = Google validates it, nothing is created

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

managerCustomerId.description: the manager (MCC) account it goes under

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York; permanent

name: create_google_ads_account
